# Changelog

URL: https://courtvisiongame.com/changelog.html

The biggest recent additions to Court Vision, newest first.

## November 2026: six new guides

- [How the simulation works](https://courtvisiongame.com/guides/how-the-simulation-works.html): how a possession is played step by step, from choosing the ball handler to shots, contests, turnovers, rebounds and fatigue.
- [Badges explained](https://courtvisiongame.com/guides/badges-explained.html): what each of the 27 normal badges adds, how players earn them, and the Sandbox-only experimental badges.
- New mode guides for [Survival](https://courtvisiongame.com/guides/survival.html), [Your Career](https://courtvisiongame.com/guides/your-career.html) and [Story Mode](https://courtvisiongame.com/guides/story-mode.html).
- [Coaching and player development](https://courtvisiongame.com/guides/coaching-and-development.html): staff, systems, rotations, practice, mentors and morale.
- Expanded guides: the [All-Time Draft](https://courtvisiongame.com/guides/all-time-draft.html) guide now explains the draft pool, snake order, how AI GMs draft by need and difficulty, and the league after the draft. [Real NBA history](https://courtvisiongame.com/guides/real-nba-history.html) now covers rating smoothing, Real Player Development, real draft classes and debuts, Real vs Yours and Time Machine.
- The main menu now has a Learn Court Vision section that links every guide.
- The privacy policy now covers Online Leagues and social features such as clubs, gifts and profile visits, and fixes its descriptions of accounts, purchases and ad consent.
- The Support Shop has been removed: Court Vision is completely free, with no purchases.
- New [Terms of Use](https://courtvisiongame.com/terms.html). Accounts are for ages 13 and up, confirmed before signing in, and support is now available by email on the [Contact](https://courtvisiongame.com/contact.html) page.

## October 2026: the 82-0 Challenge

- **82-0 Challenge:** a new mode. Build a ten-man team (Quick Spin or Franchise Spin), play all 82 games against real teams and boss teams like the 72-10 Bulls, then four playoff rounds. Scored runs, a Daily 82-0 with a weekly board, and the Undefeated and Perfection rewards.
- **Hunt squads to 82-0:** after you win a League Hunt, take that squad into an 82-0 season as a bonus run.
- **Mode of the Week:** one mode earns double XP every week.
- **Career Mode big moments:** titles, MVPs, 50-point nights, playoff heartbreak and more now ask you to make a call, worth Legacy or a summer of training.
- **Share cards in 9:16** for TikTok, Reels and Stories, with your 82-game season as a strip of wins and losses.
- **Menu:** every mode card shows how long a sitting takes, tags, the most popular and most fun picks, and what you have in progress.
- **Profile frames, a free Season Pass, a daily streak, your character on the leaderboards** and the Weekly Hunt arrived in the weeks before.

## All-Time Draft

- **06 / DRAFT, the All-Time Draft:** thirty teams, thirteen rounds, every player in history at his best season. AI GMs draft for need; your team then plays under any era's rules with the full GM game.
- **All-Time Draft of the Week:** the same order, era and AI GMs for everyone.
- **Sign in** is now on the main menu.

## Accounts, leaderboards, ranked and PvP

- **Accounts (optional):** sign in with Discord or Google; your progress follows you to every device.
- **Community:** leaderboards for GMs, created players (all-time and weekly), the Rebuild and Career of the Week, the Daily Legend, every Rebuild scenario, and your friends.
- **Public profiles** with trophies, best created players, achievements (with how rare each one is) and a follow button.
- **Ranked seasons:** monthly, with tiers from Bronze to Legend and titles to unlock.
- **League Hunt PvP:** your finished hunt squad against other GMs' squads, best of seven, Elo-rated.
- **League-code boards:** everyone who played the same league code, and how their first season went.

## End of September 2026: levels, goals and leaderboards

- **GM Profile:** one level across every mode, built from everything you have already done. Levels unlock share-card frames, Watch Game court floors (parquet, blonde maple, midnight, street) and GM titles.
- **Daily goals:** three goals a day in any official GM league, the same for everyone, paying XP.
- **Online weekly leaderboards** for the Rebuild of the Week and the Career of the Week.
- **League codes:** send a code and a friend starts the exact same league (rosters, draft classes, schedule).
- **Highlight GIFs** from Watch Game, ready for Discord.

## Late September 2026: weekly challenges and the app

- **Rebuild of the Week and Career of the Week:** a new shared challenge every Monday, the same league and the same wheel for everyone.
- **Seven new Rebuild scenarios** (19 in all): the 11-71 Mavericks and Nuggets, the 12-70 Nets, Wade alone in Miami, Orlando after T-Mac, the 13-69 Hawks and the young Giannis Bucks.
- **Install Court Vision** as an app on phones and computers. After the first visit it opens offline.
- **Graphics setting** in the menu footer: Lite mode for older phones stops looping animations and blur and uses fewer simulation workers.
- **What's new** popup once after each update.

## September 2026: new ways to play

- **Rebuild Challenge:** 12 real rock-bottom teams (19 since the late-September update), a season limit, scores, stars and a board.
- **Career Mode:** create a player on the wheel of NBA history or in MyPlayer and live his whole career, in today's league or any past draft. Hall of Fame, all-time Top 100, career moments, jersey retirements.
- **League Hunt:** spin a six-man squad from all of history and win ten best-of-seven series against the great teams of every era. Daily Legend, decks, difficulty, Album and Dream Matchup.
- **GM Locker:** every trophy you have won, across every mode.
- **Backup everything:** one file with all your progress; restore on any device.
- **Share cards:** pixel-art images of your results to post anywhere.

## September 2026: the GM game

- Trade Deadline Day, trade talks with counteroffers, three-team trades.
- Agent negotiations, in-season extensions and contract years.
- Draft Lottery and Draft Night war room; scouting department; Summer League.
- Coaching carousel, staff roles and poaching, summer development camps.
- Medical room with treatment decisions and load management.
- Sideline coaching while you watch; your playoff series and Game 7s live.
- Press conferences, storylines, franchise business (tickets, arena, merchandise) and the Year in Review show.
- Real history: mid-season trades, real draft picks, real jersey numbers and every real player's career.
- New arena and court look, team colors and logos, and a faster simulation engine.

# Contact and support

URL: https://courtvisiongame.com/contact.html

CourtVision is developed by NineFoldVision. Email [papashvilisaba4@gmail.com](mailto:papashvilisaba4@gmail.com) for support, privacy requests and anything you would rather not post publicly. The [Discord community](https://discord.gg/5uGK5HDS8e) is the place to report problems in the open and discuss the game; Discord is an external service and requires its own account.

## Report a bug

Describe the mode and action that failed, the result you expected and what actually happened. Include your browser, device and whether you were signed in or offline. Exact steps and an error screenshot are more useful than “it does not work.”

- Note the season, round or screen where the problem happened.
- Say whether it happens again after reopening the same save.
- Never post passwords, sign-in links, account tokens or payment information. Backup files contain game data: review them and agree on an appropriate support channel before sharing.

## Save and account help

Do not clear browser data when investigating a missing save. First check the same browser and profile, then look for save recovery points or a downloaded backup. The [FAQ](https://courtvisiongame.com/faq.html) explains the difference between local saves and cloud progress.

Account deletion is available from the account screen in Community. If it fails, report the error without sharing authentication details.

## Privacy requests

Read the [Privacy Policy](https://courtvisiongame.com/privacy.html) for the data disclosures and controls. Email privacy requests, such as access to or deletion of your account data, to [papashvilisaba4@gmail.com](mailto:papashvilisaba4@gmail.com). Include your GM name, but never a password or sign-in link. Do not post personal information in public Discord channels.

## Ideas and gameplay questions

For a gameplay question, begin with the [FAQ](https://courtvisiongame.com/faq.html), [beginner guide](https://courtvisiongame.com/how-to-play.html) or [mode guides](https://courtvisiongame.com/guides/). When suggesting a change, explain the situation it would improve and which mode it affects. Keeping reports specific helps a solo developer reproduce and prioritize them.

# Terms of Use

URL: https://courtvisiongame.com/terms.html

Last updated November 12, 2026. These terms apply when you play Court Vision, the free basketball management and simulation game by NineFoldVision, on courtvisiongame.com, as an installed app, or as the offline Windows edition. By playing you agree to them. If you do not agree, please do not use the game.

## 1. Who can play

- Anyone can play Court Vision without an account.
- You must be **13 or older** to create an account. Where local law sets a higher age for agreeing to online services (up to 16 in some EU countries), you must meet that age or have a parent's or guardian's permission.
- If you use the game on behalf of someone else, such as a school or club, you confirm that you are allowed to accept these terms for them.

## 2. The game is free

Court Vision is free to play and has no purchases. The web version shows advertising to help pay for it; the offline Windows edition does not. Advertising is described in the [Privacy Policy](https://courtvisiongame.com/privacy.html).

In-game items such as coins, Lucky Spins, relics, cosmetics, levels, trophies and rewards have no real-world money value. They cannot be bought, sold, traded for money or transferred outside the game. Their rules and amounts may change as the game is updated.

## 3. Accounts

- Accounts are optional and use sign-in with Discord or Google. Keep that sign-in secure: anything done while you are signed in is treated as done by you.
- One person per account. Do not share an account, or sign in to someone else's.
- You can delete your account at any time from Community → Your account. What deletion removes is explained in the [Privacy Policy](https://courtvisiongame.com/privacy.html).
- We may suspend or remove an account that breaks these terms, for example one with an offensive name or faked leaderboard results.

## 4. GM names, clubs and other things you create

Some things you create are shown to other players: your GM name and profile, club and clan names, tags, mottos and descriptions, and the teams and trades in an Online League you share with friends. You keep ownership of what you create. You allow us to store and display it in the game for as long as it is part of the game.

Names and text you create must not:

- be hateful, harassing, sexually explicit, violent or threatening;
- impersonate another person, another player or Court Vision staff;
- include personal information, such as a real full name, address, phone number or email address;
- advertise, link to other services, or break the law or anyone else's rights.

Players can report names. We may rename or remove anything that breaks these rules, without notice.

## 5. Fair play

Single-player leagues are yours to play however you like, including Sandbox mode, editing players and experimental badges.

Leaderboards, ranked seasons, PvP, clubs, clans, weekly and daily challenges, and Online Leagues are shared with other players. In those, do not:

- submit results you did not earn by playing, or change game data, requests or saves to fake results;
- use bots, scripts or automation to play, farm rewards or send requests to the game's servers;
- exploit a bug to gain an advantage instead of reporting it;
- try to get into other players' accounts or data, or disrupt the game's servers or other players' games.

We may remove results, rewards or leaderboard entries that break these rules, and suspend accounts that keep doing so.

## 6. Basketball data and ownership

Court Vision is an independent fan project. It is **not** affiliated with or endorsed by the NBA, its teams or its players. Real names and historical statistics are used to describe real basketball history; statistics come from Basketball-Reference.com, and every rating in the game is Court Vision's own estimate. Team crests and artwork are drawn for the game and are not official logos.

The game's code, artwork, text, sounds and design belong to NineFoldVision. You may share screenshots, clips and share cards of your games. Do not copy, resell or republish the game or its artwork as your own.

## 7. Saves and availability

- Leagues and most progress are saved in your browser on your own device. Clearing your browser's site data deletes them. Use **Backup everything** regularly to keep a copy.
- Online features need an internet connection and the game's servers. They may sometimes be unavailable, and they may change or end.
- The game is updated often. Features, modes, balance and rules can change, and a change can affect existing saves or progress.

## 8. No warranty and limits of liability

Court Vision is provided free and "as is". As far as the law allows, we make no promise that it will always be available, error-free or suitable for a particular purpose, or that saves or progress will never be lost.

As far as the law allows, NineFoldVision is not liable for indirect or consequential losses, or for lost data, saves or in-game items, arising from your use of the game. Nothing in these terms limits any rights you have under the consumer protection laws where you live that cannot be limited by agreement.

## 9. Links and advertising

The game links to other services, such as Discord, and shows ads served by Google. Those services and advertisers are run by others under their own terms and privacy policies. We are not responsible for their content.

## 10. Changes to these terms

We may update these terms as the game changes. When we do, we change the date at the top of this page; if a change is significant, we will say so on the site or in the game. Continuing to play after an update means you accept the new terms.

## 11. Contact

Questions about these terms, a report about a name or a player, or a request about your account: email [papashvilisaba4@gmail.com](mailto:papashvilisaba4@gmail.com), or see [Contact and support](https://courtvisiongame.com/contact.html).
